lines: - "Howdy. Our lines are open, comms and contracts what do you need?"
- "Comms are patched and Eudico's on the horn if you need work."
- "Bases locked down and comms are up. Let's get you resupplied outworlder."
- "Weather like this, I do not miss my organics. So uh, what do you need?"
- "You see something you wanna tackle? I'll get Eudico on the blower."
- "Pick a run, and I'll patch ya through."
- "Always fancied a life of action, me. 'Cept, y'know, an old injury. And an aversion to having a cauterized hole blown through me parts."
- "Gun fights? I never agreed to gun fights. I'm piking until the coast is clear."
- "I'm not getting paid to get shot at. Hell, I'm not getting paid at all! See ya."
- "I can't be seen here, got a family to consider. See you later."

path: When Leaving Without Picking a Bounty
lines: - "Wasn't expecting that, when you're normally so, you know, PEW PEW PEW."
- "Eh, copy that. See you next time."
- "Sure, sure, Tenno business. Don't let me keep ya."

- "Hoo! And THIS is WHY we get our bits replaced! Look, I'm not a fighter, me. Got a family, but a Dad's gotta do what's right for his kids. Give 'em a different future. So I'll keep standin' here in the freezing cold, just as long as you need me. You give 'em hell, Outworlder."
- "Roger? Scan your optics over this lot."
